rationale: In late stationary phase with 4 h remaining, I consume abundant formate and inositol as primary carbon sources, supplemented by arginine Stickland fermentation. Nitrogen is limiting; I take up ammonium and amino acid nitrogen. Fermentation products (acetate, propionate, butyrate, CO₂) are released to balance redox and pH. Growth is limited by nitrogen availability to ~0.40 /h.
